description: This Java class 'Utils' provides utility methods for handling Android ContentInfo objects, such as partitioning content based on a predicate and collecting URIs from ClipData.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for manipulating Android ContentInfo objects, including partitioning content and extracting URIs.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Partitions a ContentInfo payload into two ContentInfo objects based on a predicate applied to its ClipData items.

methods.name: buildClipData
methods.description: Constructs a ClipData object from a description and a list of ClipData items.

methods.name: collectUris
methods.description: Collects all Uri objects from the items in a given ClipData object.
